attorneys: Messrs. John W. Peck, Frank H. Shaffer, Jr., and Coleman Avery for petitioner. Messrs. Province M. Pogue and Henry Burton Street for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit granted, limited to the question of the jurisdiction of the District Court under § 23 (b) of the Bankruptcy Act.
